description: Digest-portability fixture for scripts/lib/productionSourceScan.mjs and scripts/lib/inventoryUniverse.mjs (verified fail-closed on every verify:workflow-production-sources run and on every route/path-consumer inventory run). All vectors are base64 so git EOL settings cannot rewrite them: text.lfBase64 and text.crlfBase64 are the SAME text in its two single-EOL representations and must both canonicalize to text.canonicalSha256; text.mutatedBase64 is genuinely different text and must not; text.lfRawSha256/crlfRawSha256 are the historical raw-byte digests the pre-gate tolerant matcher must accept from either representation; binary.bytesBase64 is NUL-bearing content with embedded CRLF bytes that must be hashed verbatim (binary.rawSha256), never line-ending-normalized; universe.lfBase64 and universe.crlfBase64 are the SAME minimal production-source-universe JSON in its two single-EOL serializations and must flow through parseUniverseTsFiles to the identical universeSha256 (universe.canonicalSha256) with identical file lists, while universe.mutatedBase64 (one digest byte changed) must not — proving sourceUniverseSha256 provenance in the route/path-consumer inventories is checkout-line-ending-independent.
